name: baboon

special_abilities.name: pack tactics
special_abilities.desc: The baboon has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the baboon's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4 - 1) piercing damage.

lore:
The Baboon, or *Papio ferox*, is a denizen of sun-scorched savannas and jagged cliffs, often claiming crumbling ruins as its citadel. Unlike the solitary predators of the veldt, the baboon hunts with a cruel, collective intelligence. A troupe does not merely attack; they besiege. Using a cacophony of rhythmic barks to disorient the senses, they encircle the unwary before descending with elongated, ivory canines that rival those of the great cats.

In local folklore, they are known as the "Laughing Sentinels." The tribes of the Red Sands whisper that baboons are the spirits of disgraced warriors, cursed to mock the living from the heights. To hear their midnight drumming upon hollow logs is considered a dire omen—a sign that the boundary between the wild and the civilized is thinning. To the seasoned traveler, their presence signifies a land that is fiercely guarded. One must never mistake their bared teeth for a grin; it is a promise of violence. Keep your fires bright and your steel closer, for the troupe watches from the shadows of the stone.
